what.question: What is MyrmAgent?
what.answer: MyrmAgent is an AI agent platform with a persistent sandbox, memory system, and GUI-first interface. It helps you research, code, and automate tasks without managing infrastructure.

pronounce.question: How do you pronounce MyrmAgent?
pronounce.answer: /ˈmɜːrm ˈeɪdʒənt/. Myrm comes from the Greek word for ant — the same root as myrmecology and our Colony Agents multi-agent metaphor.

local.question: Can I use my own API keys?
local.answer: Yes. Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) is supported — you pay your LLM provider directly for those calls while still using the full MyrmAgent workspace.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Your workspace data stays in an isolated environment under your control — persistent memory, files, and sessions are not shared with other users. In Settings → Security Policy, the **Data Flow & Privacy Disclosure** panel shows a live map of what stays local vs what egresses to third parties (LLM providers, MCP, connectors, channels) based on your current configuration — not a static vendor list. You can download a compliance export (API keys redacted) in one click. See our Privacy Policy for details.

embedWindow.question: How is retrieval quality guaranteed for long or multi-language documents?
embedWindow.answer: MyrmAgent auto-detects your embedding model's input window and derives a chunk budget matched to its tokenizer family — character-based for BERT/wordpiece models (BGE, MiniLM, E5…) to prevent silent truncation of Chinese/Japanese/Korean text. Any input that still exceeds the window fails loudly before the embedding API is called, so retrieval quality never degrades without warning.

cloudResources.question: Do I get exactly the sandbox resources my plan promises?
cloudResources.answer: Yes — every paid tier maps to a concrete container profile (CPU, memory, disk, and process limits) that is applied automatically and verified at creation, so what you pay for is exactly what runs. The Doctor panel also shows two-level process-saturation alerts (70% warn / 90% fail) before a busy sandbox ever freezes silently.

optionalExtras.question: Do I need to install every Python package manually?
optionalExtras.answer: No for most workflows. Channel SDKs (Matrix, Discord, Feishu) install on-demand from Settings with no restart. Optional skill bundles—such as WeChat article formatting—use named extras (`uv sync --extra wechat-formatter`) so Desktop stays lean while Docker can ship `--all-extras`. Missing packages surface honest install hints instead of silent mid-task failures.

memory.title: Lossless Memory · Transient Pollution Defense
memory.competitorPain: Dumps raw chats into vector databases indiscriminately, hallucinating expired orders and old balances days later as facts
memory.myrmMoat: Four-tier transient fact pollution boundary + Claim Graph namespace isolation, physically preventing transient operational data from corrupting L3 memory
memory.userBenefit: Your preferences and habits migrate smoothly without loss, and your agent will never deceive you with stale, expired context.

ptcEngine.title: Scenario-Split PTC · 95%+ Cache Lock
ptcEngine.competitorPain: Forces everything into Python code generation where minor indentation errors stall execution and reset KV Cache to zero
ptcEngine.myrmMoat: Precise scenario partitioning: 8 core operations use Direct FC, heavy computation runs in sandboxes, locking golden prefix cache permanently
ptcEngine.userBenefit: Never fail because of a missing parenthesis; cut API inference costs by up to 80% on DeepSeek and Claude.

orchestration.title: Deterministic Orchestration · Terminal Evidence Verification
orchestration.competitorPain: Sub-agents flatter each other and declare success verbally while generated code is completely broken; long tasks terminate prematurely
orchestration.myrmMoat: 8 deterministic topologies + 4-dimensional hard budgets + CompletionGuard verifying physical terminal STDOUT execution logs
orchestration.userBenefit: Eliminates AI mutual praise and false handoffs; every sub-task must present authentic terminal test execution evidence.

omnichannel.title: Triple-Platform Isomorphism · Exclusive IM /undo Recovery
omnichannel.competitorPain: Terminal black box that disconnects once you step away; impossible to undo or rescue broken files triggered via mobile messaging
omnichannel.myrmMoat: WebUI + Native Desktop + 35+ messaging channels, featuring industry-first IM /undo linked with physical filesystem rollback
omnichannel.userBenefit: Command your agent on the go via Slack, WeChat, or Telegram; if an accidental command breaks code, a single /undo command rolls it back instantly.

security.title: Zero-Disk Vault · Air-Gapped Physical Sandbox
security.competitorPain: Exposes open ports 0.0.0.0 turning into crypto-miners; scripts dump .env stealing thousands in API keys; prompt injections corrupt rules permanently
security.myrmMoat: Strictly Zero-Disk OS Keychain master storage + default 127.0.0.1 loopback lock with DNS Rebinding guard + kernel read-only rules + air-gapped sandbox
security.userBenefit: Enterprise-grade security you can actually trust in production: keys never touch disk in plaintext, scripts cannot steal tokens, and attacks are stopped at the root.
